hero.body1: Endless WhatsApp messages, chaotic group chats, confirmations that never arrive, duplicate or useless gifts.
hero.body2: With Piky you plan the party, share the link and guests confirm their attendance and book gifts. No overlaps, no chaos.

final_cta.title: Ready to plan the party?
final_cta.body: It takes less than 5 minutes. Name, date and venue, add the gifts, copy the link and share it with your guests.
final_cta.share_text: Takes just 5 min. Try it for free!

rsvp.title: Attendance confirmation
rsvp.description: Guests confirm their attendance (I'll be there / maybe / can't make it) directly in the list.

nodup.title: Gift list without duplicates
nodup.description: When someone books a gift it becomes invisible to other guests. Zero overlaps, zero awkwardness.

collective.title: Group gift
collective.description: Guests book their share and bring cash on the day, or pay directly via PayPal. Real-time progress bar.

private.title: Private link
private.description: A private link to share with your guests — only those who receive it can see the list.

reminders.title: Automatic reminders
reminders.description: Automatic notification when the list closes with a summary of attendees and booked gifts. Reminder the day after the party to thank your guests.

thanks.title: Thank-you messages
thanks.description: Send personalised post-party messages to all attendees in one click.

1.title: Plan the party
1.description: Enter the party details: name of the birthday child, date, venue and desired gifts with Amazon or shop links.

2.title: Share the link
2.description: Get a private link to share with guests — only those who receive it can see the list and confirm their attendance.

3.title: Guests book gifts
3.description: Each guest confirms their attendance and, if they wish, exclusively books a gift. Zero duplicates, zero awkwardness.

4.title: Track everything from your area
4.description: See who opened the link, who booked what, confirmed attendees and contributions to the group gift.
